messages.text: Searched the catalog · Wingbits MGW310 WB300 gateway

Good to know. Heads up on that one though: the MGW310's buyable version is out of stock right now — the only live variant is RMA-only, which isn't a normal purchase.

Worth knowing it's also not a Bitcoin miner. It tracks aircraft and does RTK, earns $GEOD plus Wingbits points, and it has to be mounted outdoors.

Are you after DePIN earnings like that, or actual Bitcoin hashrate? And which country are you in — that decides what I can get to you.
